sections.title: Talking time
sections.text:
Well done, Shenshen!
Thank you, Minmin.
Shenshen, I still remember the first time I met you. You were shy and quiet. But you are so confident today.
Yeah, I used to be very nervous to speak in front of my schoolmates.
You are now a good storyteller. How did you make it?
To me, telling stories to lots of people is really cool. I learned from videos and did a lot of practice.
What else?
I told stories to my family. They made videos for me and gave me advice.
I see. Love and practice make a better you.
Find the rule: You were shy and quiet. I was very nervous to speak in front of my schoolmates. He was not good at singing at first.

sections.title: Story time
sections.text:
My left foot
When I was four months old, I was sick. The only body part I could control was my left foot.
My mum didn’t give up. She taught me how to read and write. ‘Do you like this story?’ she asked, ‘Nod your head for yes.’
I couldn’t make any signs, but Mum told me more stories.
When I was five, I was still unable to speak. One day, I was watching my sister using a piece of yellow chalk to write.
Then I took the chalk from my sister with my left foot. Very slowly, I held the chalk tightly between my toes and wrote the letter A!
I couldn’t speak, but that one letter was my road to a new world.

sections.text:
A letter to future me
10 December
Dear future me,
Do you still remember about Shenshen in Grade 5? You eat vegetables and fresh fruit to have a healthy diet. You do exercise every day to become stronger. You read a lot, write stories and do not give up storytelling. Are you proud of Shenshen in Grade 5?
Shenshen
